props.title: Dynamic Columns Table
props.description: Static spec, runtime-unknown columns — rows repeat /data, cells repeat /colDefs. Switching datasets changes the column set with zero spec regeneration.
props.technicalDescription:
Spec
CaseContainer → StackRow [ActionButton×3] + Table → [THead → Tr (repeat: /colDefs → ColumnHeader), TBody (repeat: /data, key: __id → Tr → repeat: /colDefs → DataCell)]
State
{ data: Array<Record> — enriched with __id, colDefs: Array<{ key, label }> — derived at load, dataset: name }
Features
• Scope stack — DataCell reads the column key from its own repeat scope (usePath()) and binds the value at the row scope (usePath(1))
• Static spec — column set changes at runtime via /colDefs; no spec regeneration, no full re-render
• Per-cell subscriptions — editing one cell re-renders only that cell
• Ragged rows — column union across all rows; missing keys render empty
